title: Ellie Elephant's Quiet Song
description: Ellie worries her booming voice is too loud, until she discovers how to sing a soft lullaby to help a little bird sleep.

scenes.narration: Ellie Elephant loved music, but her big trunk made every sound feel like a booming thunderclap across the sleepy jungle.
scenes.visual: A friendly baby elephant wearing a flower crown sitting under jungle leaves

scenes.narration: She was so worried about disturbing her friends that she stopped making any sounds at all, tiptoeing quietly through the high ferns.
scenes.visual: An elephant looking down nervously while other jungle animals sleep softly

scenes.narration: High up in an acacia tree, a tiny baby robin chirped sadly. It was nighttime, but the little bird could not drift off to sleep.
scenes.visual: A tiny red robin sitting shivering on a low wooden tree branch

scenes.narration: Ellie walked gently to the tree, rested her trunk near the nest, and blew out the softest, warmest breath of breeze she could manage.
scenes.visual: An elephant kneeling down close to a tiny bird nest in a tree

scenes.narration: She hummed a low, soothing tune that sounded like a quiet summer night. The baby robin closed its eyes and snuggled into its warm nest.
scenes.visual: A small bird sleeping peacefully curled up inside a warm feather nest

scenes.narration: Ellie smiled happily. She realized that even big voices can be soft, gentle, and comforting when used with care.
scenes.visual: An elephant and a little bird cozy together under soft green fronds

scenes.narration: Let the gentle jungle lullaby soothe you to sleep tonight. Follow along for more sweet dreams every evening.
scenes.visual: A peaceful jungle sunset with glowing purple sky and gentle trees
